one_liner: Nikola Jokic anchors the Denver Nuggets at 51.2 points-plus-rebounds-plus-assists per 36 minutes -- the highest top-contributor rate among all 30 teams in the sample.
three_things: Jokic's 51.2 combined PRA-per-36 is the top such rate across all 30 teams in the sample.
He is also the team's minutes leader at 7,429.0 total minutes.
Denver posted the highest latest-season scoring in the sample at 121.4 points per game.
context_note: The 'top contributor' is the player with the most total minutes for the team, which for Denver coincides with its best player. PRA-per-36 sums points, rebounds, and assists per 36 minutes and is a raw box rate, not an impact metric, so the cross-team ranking describes box production, not measured value. ppg_latest_season is a single-season team average while the rest of the sample spans three seasons; pace_proxy is a proxy, not official possession-based pace. The manifest is descriptive_only with no schedule or opponent adjustment.
